request.description: The CA inbox, newest first. `view`: `offered` (waiting for accept or decline, with `respondBy`), `active` (accepted or being worked), `closed` (completed, declined, expired, revoked or returned); without `view`, offered and active together. Paginate with `cursor`. Partner context. The firm owner sees every lead offered to the firm; a firm member (agent) sees only leads the owner handed to them. Lead protection: before acceptance the name is shortened (e.g. `Ramesh K.`) and the business name and notes are hidden; contact details stay masked until revealed, and every reveal is logged.

response.name: 200 OK
